name: Giardino Italian Restaurant
summary: The current Springfield ordering surfaces confirm Giardino Italian Restaurant at 8944 Burke Lake Road and expose a conventional item-level catalog. The frozen PDF extraction split most menu descriptions, prices, modifiers, and ingredient phrases into false products: 68 of 87 frozen rows are therefore classified as artifacts, while 19 genuine item names reconcile to current products. Current item-level products omitted by that extraction are added from the linked ordering catalogs. Required searches found no restaurant-issued allergen matrix or cross-contact policy; only explicit ingredient-derived positives on surviving official-menu products are retained.
